description: Header file for the CanIf module in an AUTOSAR-based Arctic Core platform, defining interfaces, constants, and macros for CAN interface functionality.

methods.name: CanIf_Init
methods.description: Initializes the CAN Interface module with the provided configuration.

methods.name: CanIf_InitController
methods.description: Initializes a specific CAN controller with a given configuration index.

methods.name: CanIf_SetControllerMode
methods.description: Sets the mode of a specified CAN controller.

methods.name: CanIf_GetControllerMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current mode of a specified CAN controller.

methods.name: CanIf_Transmit
methods.description: Transmits a PDU via CAN.

methods.name: CanIf_ReadRxPduData
methods.description: Reads received PDU data from CAN.

methods.name: CanIf_ReadTxNotifStatus
methods.description: Reads the transmission notification status.

methods.name: CanIf_ReadRxNotifStatus
methods.description: Reads the reception notification status.

methods.name: CanIf_SetPduMode
methods.description: Sets the PDU mode for a controller.

methods.name: CanIf_GetPduMode
methods.description: Gets the current PDU mode for a controller.

methods.name: CanIf_SetDynamicTxId
methods.description: Sets a dynamic transmit ID for a PDU.

methods.name: CanIf_FindTxPduEntry
methods.description: Finds a transmit PDU entry by ID.

methods.name: CanIf_FindRxPduEntry
methods.description: Finds a receive PDU entry by ID.

methods.name: CanIf_Arc_GetReceiveHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the receive handler for a channel.

methods.name: CanIf_Arc_GetTransmitHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the transmit handler for a channel.

methods.name: CanIf_SetTransceiverMode
methods.description: Sets the transceiver mode.

methods.name: CanIf_GetTransceiverMode
methods.description: Gets the transceiver mode.

methods.name: CanIf_GetTrcvWakeupReason
methods.description: Retrieves the wakeup reason for a transceiver.

methods.name: CanIf_SetTransceiverWakeupMode
methods.description: Sets the wakeup mode for a transceiver.

methods.name: CanIf_CheckWakeup
methods.description: Checks if a wakeup event occurred.

methods.name: CanIf_CheckValidation
methods.description: Validates a wakeup event.

methods.name: CanIf_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves version information of the CanIf module.

methods.name: CanIf_Arc_GetChannelDefaultConfIndex
methods.description: Gets default configuration index for a channel.
